content:
lena: quick heads-up 1 - EdgeGrid (HW partner) sent their marketplace compliance packet. They included full firmware + manifest. Legal flagged it: we need a short playbook for what we publish vs what stays restricted.
tom: thanks. can we enumerate the artifacts they sent?
cleo-partner: listing of attachments from EdgeGrid: firmware-v3.4.1.bin, manifest-v3.4.1.json (fields: model, version, serial, hw_id, signer_cert), soc2-scoped-excerpt.pdf, pen-report-2025-01 (redacted), supplier-questionnaire.pdf
frank-legal: we want only the following public: manifest metadata WITH serial & hw_id redacted, soc2 excerpt (controls summary only), and a one-paragraph attestation from EdgeGrid. Full firmware and full pen-report must be available only to authorized reviewers under NDA. Also need an evidence access clause in the marketplace listing copy.
nashley-sec: Agreed. I recommend three tracks: PUBLIC (listing bundle), RESTRICTED-PRESIGN (vendor reviewers), and SECURE-ARCHIVE (raw evidence). Rules: - PUBLIC must have all unique device identifiers removed; replace with placeholders (e.g., <REDACTED-ID-1>). - PRESIGN links are time-limited, role-scoped, and require an access request record. - ARCHIVE is S3 with MFA delete, KMS CMK, restricted to security+legal+partner-liaison.
lena: can someone sketch an exact redaction pattern for the manifest JSON so SI can run it? small example please.
tom: small jq example that will zero out fields, run on manifest.json: ```bash
jq '.serial = "REDACTED" | .hw_id = "REDACTED" | .signer_cert = "REDACTED"' manifest.json > manifest.public.json
```
cleo-partner: perfect. also note: signer_cert is a PEM block in the manifest - ensure we don't publish cert blobs.
security-bot: SECURITY NOTE: confirm SHA256 of both redacted manifest and published bundle and store hashes in audit log.
frank-legal: legal paragraph draft suggestion: "Redwood Inference and EdgeGrid have removed sensitive device identifiers from the public package. Full artifacts, including firmware and detailed penetration testing reports, are available to authorized parties under NDA upon request."
nashley-sec: one more: SOC2 excerpt must be limited to controls relevant to change management and crypto key handling; redact account/email names in the excerpt. Also add a one-line control owner mapping table in the restricted package.
lena: owner mapping (proposed): firmware signing -> tom; key custody -> ashley-sec; vulnerability testing -> cleo-partner; legal attestations -> frank-legal. Anyone object?
tom: looks good. I'll run the redaction and create the presign. timeline: I can do redaction+public bundle today, presign to SI vendor tomorrow morning.
cleo-partner: we need a small checklist to send EdgeGrid so they know what to prepare for the reviewer NDA window. Can we include required contact fields (name, role, email), preferred vuln-scan witness window, and required attestation signature?
frank-legal: yes send them a checklist: 1) Signed attestation PDF 2) Contact name/email for responsible security lead 3) Confirmation that firmware private keys were never shared 4) Scope of pen-test and date
security-bot: operation tips: - presign TTL = 7 days default - vendor IAM role recommended - single-download audit (work with ops to restrict to single GET if possible) - cloudtrail capture event_name=GetObject for audit trail
lena: ok final deliverables for marketplace listing: A) manifest.public.json (redacted) B) soc2-controls-summary.pdf (redacted) C) one-line attestation from EdgeGrid D) listing copy snippet from frank-legal. Restricted deliverables: presigned link to firmware.tar.gz + redacted pen-report for vendor reviewers. Secure archive: raw firmware + full pen-report stored with retention=12 months.
tom: I'll post the presign link + SHA256 in this thread once uploaded to s3://marketplace-evidence/edgegrid/2025-03/. Also will attach the small runbook for reviewers (how to request access).
cleo-partner: I'll coordinate the vendor NDA and witness window.
frank-legal: I'll review the listing copy and finalize the legal paragraph.
nashley-sec: Thanks all. tagging this thread as the canonical handshake for EdgeGrid marketplace artifacts. :lock: :white_check_mark:
lena: awesome 1. If anything changes ping @lena.
